items.summary: HEAVY CEILING-PATH STEP (B) — re-enable the trained value head at MCTS leaves (r12-selfplay-gate-throughput.md item 4, DEFERRED to R111). Surfaced as its own queue entry 2026-05-21 (previously buried as a one-line pointer inside r12-throughput DONE). Root mechanism behind the iter-2-peak-then-rot ceiling: in rollout-leaf mode the trained value head is never used at gate/self-play (backend/src/sim/mcts.ts:552-555), so the loop has NO improving signal feeding back into MCTS across iters (rule-bot rollouts at leaves are fixed quality). Without an improving leaf signal, the loop can only drift — and drifts softer because targets aren't one-hot and there's no force pulling entropy down. Re-enabling the value head at leaves gives the loop a positive gradient toward ground-truth z (terminal outcomes), which is what would let visits ratchet SHARPER instead of softer across iters. COST: changes the learning targets, breaks the R110 A/B chain (R110-W6 production claim 96-d 0.6479 is rollout-leaf-based); any new run establishes a new baseline. Deferred for research-methodology, not technical, reasons.

items.summary: Relabel MCTS bleeds the shared AsyncLocalStorage RNG into the game's deterministic trajectory. Surfaced as a secondary finding in chunk 5i (runs/R16-TD-3a-prod-corpus-400sim-rulebot/flip-analysis.json:recipe_invariant_check): rule-bot-mirror at --mcts-simulations 400 produced 4233 rows vs 4196 at 100 sims (state-identical intersection 63.8% of 100-sim rows) despite --selection baseline being deterministic — only 63.8% of (seed,modelSide,step) keys carried identical legalActions across sim counts. Root-cause hypothesis: relabel MCTS consumes the shared AsyncLocalStorage RNG via the global random() proxy in frontend/src/game/engine/core/random.ts (storageProvider.get()?.next() ?? Math.random()), so additional sims perturb the game's RNG before the next baseline move. Invalidates the chunk-5h 'deterministic row-by-row diff at 4× sims' design; salvageable for the chunk-5i verdict (state-identical subset still yielded a 95% CI well below the 30% LIVES threshold) but invalidates any future sim-count A/B comparison until fixed. NOT on the critical path of active research — the active research line (chunks 5g+5h+5i) already concluded candidate-1 dies; this is forward-looking infra.
items.next_action: DEFERRED, not blocking. Fire only if a sim-count A/B becomes load-bearing again (e.g. reframed step 1 chooses a sim-count axis). Two fix sketches: (a) isolate relabel MCTS in its own RNG context — wrap runMctsRelabel in a separate AsyncLocalStorage.run with a forked RNG so sims do not consume the game's RNG token stream; or (b) two-pass design — generate the corpus once at low sims, then re-relabel only policyTargets (no game re-run) at higher sims against the recorded GameState. Option (b) also makes sim-count sweeps trivially cheap (no extra game wall-clock). Pointer: docs/ai-research/progress/r16.md sub-§ 'Step 2 verdict (chunk 5i)' secondary finding.
